notes.title: Our new game, Forest of Death Masks, has been released!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445530/Forest_of_Death_Masks/

"Forest of Death Masks" is a direct sequel to the visual novel "The Apple Tree". Solve a new case together with the police Captain Christian Tyler!

After the scandalous Cronford serial murder case, Christian Tyler found herself in a difficult position. As a coin can't have just one side, 'the local heroine' title was instantly mixed up with the dubious details of the solved crime. The police station was besieged by journalists, and given the captain's ability to communicate with the public, the entire police department was under threat.

That is why she is now standing under the scorching sun with a suitcase in her hands. The Corcante Embassy has requested an investigator to solve the case of the kidnapping of a famous businessman, and who better than a local heroine is suitable for this role? That's how you can hide her away from the media, right?

But the darkness that lives in the captain's head has not completely weakened yet. And in this strange, abandoned place, surrounded by kilometers of forest on the one hand, and the endless ocean on the other, it flares up with renewed vigor. The predator is on her heels, and Christian will once again have to maneuver on the edge of life and death, trying to overcome her demons.

* More than 70 thousand words
* More than 25 illustrations
* Original soundtrack
* Four endings

notes.title: Updating the "Gear of Glass" with long-awaited achievements!
notes.content:
The following changes have occurred in the game:


The entire game code has been rewrite from version Ren'py 6.19 to 7.4.10
Added 41 achievements
Changed in-game menus
Changed the save and load screens
Added message history log
Character names are now centered
The menu window is no longer stretched
Minor errors in the text have been fixed
Fixed a bug with the voice slider in the settings
Made it easier to pass the clicker in Jeremy's route
The appearance of the clinker in Jeremy's route has been changed

Special thanks to Lian, Alexander Tsinkin and Saya for their help in creating the update!

notes.title: A completely updated translation of "Gear of Glass"!
notes.content:
The update includes:
- Fully updated translation of "Gear of Glass: Eolarn's war"
- Fixed mistakes with gender pronouns
- Fixed bugs in the Russian version of the game
- Updated interface
- Changed appearance of in-game menu
And much more. Many thanks to Tina Ryu for the help!

Attention! Some saves from the old version may not work on this version of the game.

notes.title: Our new visual novel is coming soon!
notes.content:
Probably everyone has experienced this state after sleep. The moment when your mind has not yet emerged from the embrace of Morpheus, but is already approaching the surface to take a breath of air.
The moment when you instinctively ask yourself: "Who am I?", "Where am I?" to fully return to the world of reality.
But this time it wasn't a moment. You are standing in the middle of a phantasmagoric landscape and asking the same questions. But you don't have the answer to them in your head.
Endlessly watching eyes overhead. Strange people beckoning you to them. Which of them should you trust?
Try to get out of the tangle of secrets and return home.

Our new visual novel is already in the "Coming Soon" section! Add to the wishlist!

Link to the page in the store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1851060/Mysteria_of_the_World_The_forest_of_Death/
